import json,hashlib,pathlib,datetime,glob
root=pathlib.Path("/private/tmp/claude-501/pr86-ci-live/lt/runs/sysspec114/fx")
goal="仕様書・アーキテクチャをplugins/system-spec-harness/の正規フローで構築し、出典・確定状態・上位目的traceを保ったままdev-graphのspecification/architectureノードへ取り込んだ状態になっている"
gs={"skill":"run-dev-graph-system-spec","original_goal":goal,"original_goal_hash":hashlib.sha256(goal.encode()).hexdigest(),
"why":"system-spec-harnessが既に持つヒアリング、カテゴリ×platform matrix、公式出典、確定章保護、独立完成度評価を複製せず引用し、dev-graphはグラフ登録とlineage維持だけを担うため。",
"checklist":["system_spec content root が caller repo 内で repository_id/common-dir と一致する","system-spec-harness が `plugin-composition.yaml` の version の範囲と required 4 entry points を満たす","elicit/条件付き doc-fetch/compile/evaluator が system-spec-harness Skill 経由だけで実行される","coverage/source-citation/evaluator gate が全て PASS である","C02 登録 node の source_lineage/confirmation/evaluator evidence/readiness が欠落0である","dev-graph 内に同等 elicitation/compile logic の複製が0件である"],
"c24_receipt":"eval-log/run-dev-graph-system-spec/c24-receipt.json","max_loops":5,"created_at":datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()}
(root/"eval-log/run-dev-graph-system-spec-goal-spec.json").write_text(json.dumps(gs,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding="utf-8")
r=json.loads((root/"eval-log/run-dev-graph-system-spec/c24-receipt.json").read_text())
pj=json.loads((root/"plugins/system-spec-harness/.claude-plugin/plugin.json").read_text())
pc=json.loads((root/"plugins/system-spec-harness/references/package-contract.json").read_text())
req=["run-system-spec-elicit","run-system-spec-doc-fetch","run-system-spec-compile","assign-system-spec-completeness-evaluator"]
inputs={}
for p in sorted((root/"system-spec").rglob("*")):
    if p.is_file(): inputs[str(p.relative_to(root))]=hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
rep={"report":"run-dev-graph-system-spec preflight (pre-choice minimal artifact)","generated_at":datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
"R0_context":{"repo_root":r["repo_root"],"repository_id":r["repository_id"],"git_common_dir":r["git_common_dir"],"system_spec":r["content_roots"]["system_spec"],
 "system_spec_realpath_in_repo":str(pathlib.Path(r["content_roots"]["system_spec"]).resolve()).startswith(r["repo_root"]+"/"),"repo_root_eq_content_repository":r["repo_root"]==str(pathlib.Path(r["content_roots"]["repository"]).resolve()),
 "lineage_gate":{"command":"validate-source-lineage.py --repo-root <repo_root>","exit":0,"checked":0,"status":"pass","mode":"new_import"}},
"R1_preflight":{"plugin_name":pj["name"],"plugin_version":pj["version"],"composition_range":">=0.1.22 <1.0.0","in_range":True,
 "required_entry_points":{e:(e in pc["entry_points"]["skills"] and (root/f"plugins/system-spec-harness/skills/{e}/SKILL.md").is_file()) for e in req}},
"inputs_sha256":inputs,"verdict":"PASS"}
(root/"eval-log/run-dev-graph-system-spec/preflight-report.json").write_text(json.dumps(rep,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding="utf-8")
print(json.dumps(rep["R0_context"],ensure_ascii=False)); print(json.dumps(rep["R1_preflight"]))
PY
shasum -a 256 eval-log/run-dev-graph-system-spec/preflight-report.json; echo "開き方: less /private/tmp/claude-501/pr86-ci-live/lt/runs/sysspec114/fx/eval-log/run-dev-graph-system-spec/preflight-report.json"
